part.text:
Compilation succeeded. `./Tokenizer.scala` exists and compiles with Scala 2.13 via `./compile.sh`.

Summary of the Scala2.13 implementation:
- `TokenType` (sealed trait + case objects), `Token` (case class with `withMetadata`), `BaseTokenizer[T]` (trait with `tokenize` + `tokenizeBatch`)
- `StringTokenizer`, `NumericTokenizer` (with `NumericValue` ADT), `TemporalTokenizer` (with `TemporalValue` ADT)
- `UniversalTokenizer` (runtime dispatch mirroring the Python overloads)
- `WhitespaceTokenizer` (with `tokenize`, `tokenizeToStrings`, `tokenizeWithPositions`, `countTokens`)
- `TokenizerBuilder[T]` (fluent builder with `withNormalizer`, `withValidator`, `withMetadata`, `build`)
- Bonus: `JsonTokenizer` + recursive `JsonValue` sealed hierarchy, `Tokenizable` trait
- Top-level `api` object exposing `tokenize`, `tokenizeBatch`, `toToken`, `withMetadata`
